method: Bounded PC-literal object tracing, fixed PyGhidra ARMv5T windows, and raw V3.8/Beta3 range comparison. No firmware execution or hardware access.

rule.normal_path: stores parsed signed value and byte-4-derived selector

dispatcher_relation.input_dispatcher: 0x80004390 case 2 writes input-derived r1 to control +0x08
dispatcher_relation.task_dispatcher: 0x80005b70 case 2 writes input-derived r1 to control +0x08 and constructs a three-word sequence ending in r5=0x1d
dispatcher_relation.case_5_contrast: case 5 writes control +0x08 = 0x22, so it cannot satisfy the visible 0x0d/0x0e saturation selector check
dispatcher_relation.limit: Dispatcher cases and input fields are not mapped to physical measurement modes.
